name: residual-exploration-211
hypothesis: After 9216 extra games, four development checkpoints remain 57-59%; greedy changes concentrated in responses. Test broader on-policy sampling without new rewards or hand-coded action scores.
parentSelection: Highest team development point estimate among all four declared checkpoints, not statistically proven best. Preserve every checkpoint.
initialization: Both arms copy identical actor/critic weights and start fresh Adam/RNG. Explicit new curriculum, not optimizer-preserving resume.

development.report: All four evaluations plus matched between-arm comparison; diagnostics for response/action/skill/overflow changes. Reused development seeds, not acceptance.

reward: Terminal team +/-1 only; temperature changes sampling and matching PPO likelihood, no entropy bonus.
decision: Compare all endpoints, preserve regression and uncertainty. No automatic deployment. If no convincing gain, inspect representation/preview limitations rather than blindly scale same training.
